subject.title: fix(tlon): add timeouts to file upload HTTP requests

question: Should Tlon uploads enforce the proposed 30s lookup and 120s upload deadlines by default?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the hard upload deadline changes slow-network behavior and the current proof does not exercise a real stalled request.

options.title: Accept After Real Proof
options.body: Require redacted real or loopback upload timeout proof, then merge with the proposed 30s/120s defaults if the behavior matches maintainer intent.

options.title: Tune Deadlines First
options.body: Ask the author to adjust the timeout constants or coverage if maintainers want a longer upload budget for slow or large files.

options.title: Hold For Tlon Owner Review
options.body: Pause until a Tlon area owner confirms the user-facing tradeoff for hosted Memex and custom S3 uploads.

recommendation.title: Accept After Real Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real or loopback upload timeout proof, then merge with the proposed 30s/120s defaults if the behavior matches maintainer intent.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the strongest current-main routing signal for the Tlon upload file and shared guarded-fetch timeout seam.
